北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 晴好天气，气温较高，注意防晒补水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and warm, remember sun protection and hydration!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨伴 7 级大风，体感较凉，风雨交加注意保暖。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Light rain with 7-level winds, feels cool. Stay warm and safe in the wind and rain.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 天气阴沉湿度高，出门带伞，体感微闷哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Overcast and humid, take an umbrella, it feels a bit muggy.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天热，记得多喝水，小心别中暑啦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and hot, drink plenty of water to avoid heatstroke!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 炎热多云，体感 34℃，防晒补水很重要！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Hot and partly cloudy, feels like 34℃, sun protection and hydration are key!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 大雨倾盆，路面湿滑，出行请备雨具，注意安全。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Heavy rain, roads are slick. Bring rain gear and be careful when out.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨伴 7 级大风，体感较凉，风雨交加注意保暖安全。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Light rain with 7-level winds, feels cool. Stay warm and safe in the wind and rain.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 晴热高温，体感 36℃，出门记得防晒补水哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and very hot, feels like 36℃. Don't forget sun protection and hydration!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天有阵风，湿度大，体感微凉，记得带件外套。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Overcast with gusts and high humidity, feels a bit cool. Bring a light jacket.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 晴热天气，气温 31℃，注意防晒和多喝水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot, 31℃. Remember sun protection and drink plenty of water.
西安.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 多云天气，体感 31℃ 略闷，外出注意防晒。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy, feels like 31℃ and a bit muggy. Mind the sun when out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗好天气，气温适宜，外出游玩心情好！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Clear and pleasant weather, perfect for outdoor activities!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴热天，气温 30℃，防晒补水别忘了。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and hot, 30℃. Don't forget sun protection and hydration.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨绵绵，气温 17℃，体感 13℃，出门多穿衣。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Light rain, 17℃ but feels like 13℃. Dress warmly when you go out.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降14℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 多云阵风 5 级，海边风大，出门注意防风哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy with 5-level gusts, windy by the sea. Be mindful of strong winds!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天有阵风，湿度高，海边注意防风，记得带伞。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Overcast with gusts and high humidity. Mind the wind by the sea, bring an umbrella.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 多云湿度高，体感稍闷，出门记得带伞哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy with high humidity, feels a bit muggy. Remember to bring an umbrella.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 多云炎热，气温 31℃，注意防晒和及时补水。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Partly cloudy and hot, 31℃. Remember sun protection and stay hydrated.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 中雨加阵风，外出带伞防风，路面湿滑，注意安全。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Moderate rain and gusts, bring an umbrella, roads are slippery, stay safe!
慈溪.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃
